editorial.blurb: Parson's Chicken & Fish is a Logan Square destination where crispy, flavorful fried chicken and fresh fish are treated with genuine care and personality.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Nashville hot chicken sandwich and the 6-piece fish fry together to settle the eternal debate—both are excellent. Don't skip the hush puppies or try their frozen negroni, which regulars rave about.
signatureDishes: 6 piece fish fry with pickles and hush puppies
